justification: Fixes two live-reproduced silent data corruptions serving WRONG risk numbers to users today (#745 D1+D2): a fake 100% satellite flood frequency on dry lots firing a false user-facing flood constraint, and a storm initial-loss parameter mislabelled as the 1% AEP rainfall depth. Both fixes are fail-closed; critical tier because these are user-facing hazard figures.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads the DEA WOfS WCS GeoTIFF and the ARR Data Hub JSON live per request; no stored rows change. Downstream consumers (risk level, compound constraints, brief Climate section) already handle None as unavailable.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If DEA stops naming a band 'frequency' or ARR never serves an IFD layer, both functions return None and the UI shows checked-unavailable — missing beats known-wrong (repo Data Integrity rule).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every future flood/climate fetch; no backfill exists because neither value is persisted.
pre_impl.external_source_error: API failures already returned None; this change extends fail-closed to WRONG-SHAPED successes (unstable band order, absent IFD layer).
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend type changes required — the existing checked-unavailable render states already cover None for both the WOfS line and extreme_rainfall.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Instead of a false 100% flood signal or a fabricated 6.8mm rainfall figure, users see the flood satellite line and extreme-rainfall line as checked-but-unavailable until sources behave/are replaced.

functions.name: _wofs_frequency_from_bands
functions.input: band description names and per-band pixel values from the WCS GeoTIFF
functions.output: the 0-1 frequency from the band NAMED frequency, or None fail-closed
functions.if_none: no band named frequency, nodata, NaN, or any value outside [0,1] returns None — never a positional read, never a clamp

functions.name: _query_dea_wofs
functions.input: lat/lng sampled against the DEA WOfS multi-year composite via WCS
functions.output: dea_wofs_frequency_pct 0-100 or None on any failure or wrong shape
functions.if_none: downstream risk scoring and compound constraints treat None as no satellite signal — the false flood constraint cannot fire from a band-order artifact

functions.name: fetch_arr_ifd
functions.input: lat/lng queried against the ARR Data Hub JSON layers
functions.output: IFD table dict ONLY when a layer keyed as IFD exists, else None
functions.if_none: BurstIL (storm initial loss) is never consumed as rainfall depth; the brief marks extreme_rainfall unavailable until a genuine BOM IFD source is wired (sourcing decision tracked in #745)

values.value: band descriptions tuple on the rasterio dataset
values.if_missing: empty or unnamed descriptions return None — no positional fallback

values.value: layers dict keys in the ARR response
values.if_missing: no IFD-keyed layer means None; BurstIL presence alone never produces a value

break_it.scenario: DEA WCS returns bands in a swapped order so positional band 3 is a count, shown as 100% flood frequency on a dry lot
break_it.what_happens: Users saw a false 'satellite flood evidence detected' warning; risk level forced to elevated (live-reproduced at Concord AND rural Dubbo)
break_it.how: services/flood_truth.py — band selected by name from ds.descriptions; live-verified post-fix: Concord 0.04%, Dubbo 0.0%, Parramatta River 0.5%

break_it.scenario: A frequency-band value above 1.0 gets clamped into a plausible percentage instead of failing
break_it.what_happens: The clamp masked the band-identity bug for months by converting counts into fake percentages
break_it.how: services/flood_truth.py — out-of-range values return None with a warning; old clamp tests inverted to pin fail-closed

break_it.scenario: ARR Data Hub serves BurstIL storm initial loss and the code labels it as the 1% AEP 60-min rainfall depth
break_it.what_happens: Users saw 6.8mm where Sydney's true design rainfall is ~90-100mm, under a fabricated 'BOM IFD' source label
break_it.how: services/portal_constraints.py — only a layer keyed as IFD is served; BurstIL-only payloads return None (live endpoint shape pinned in test)

break_it.scenario: A future genuine IFD layer appears but the code keeps failing closed or mixes tables
break_it.what_happens: Real data would be discarded, or worse, BurstIL preferred over IFD when both exist
break_it.how: IFD-keyed layer is served with the 1% 60-min cell selected from IT (96.3), never BurstIL's 6.8 in the same payload

break_it.scenario: Downstream risk scoring still treats a None WOfS frequency as zero-then-elevated via the effective_pct fallback chain
break_it.what_happens: A failed satellite read could still contribute to risk level or the satellite-flood compound constraint
break_it.how: flood_truth risk chain reads dea_wofs_frequency_pct or 0.0 so None contributes nothing, and compound_constraints requires flood_wofs_pct is not None AND > 2.0 — pinned by the full suite (2,939 passed) with the new None paths

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — regenerate the Concord brief after Railway deploy: WOfS line reads ~0.04% (or unavailable), the false flood compound constraint is gone, and extreme_rainfall shows checked-unavailable until a real IFD source is chosen
